'''Rislyn''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] in a [[Mirror World]].
== History ==
Rislyn is given charge of the defenses of the [[White Tower]] in the absence of the [[Amyrlin Seat]], much to the displeasure of [[Sephraem]].<ref name="videogame">''[[The Wheel of Time (video game)|The Wheel of Time]]</ref>
